articles.title: An Easton church has been converted to a $1.3m home
articles.description:
Built in 1892 by the Swedish Evangelical Lutheran Church Society, 16 Williams St. in Easton served as a community space for young Swedish immigrants.

The post An Easton church has been converted to a $1.3m home appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Easton church at 16 Williams St. converted into a $1.3 million home.
Originally built in 1892 for Swedish immigrants by the Swedish Evangelical Lutheran Church Society.
Conversion may influence local real estate values and community heritage preservation efforts.
